◈ News

Research milestones, university recognition, professional honors, and selected developments in battery technology.

June 16, 2025 · ACS Energy Letters

Porous Liquid Electrolytes Open a New Design Space for Safer, More Efficient Batteries

A Perspective by Mehran Arzani, Hamidreza Mahdavi, and Vikas Berry introduces porous liquid-based electrolytes as a molecularly engineered platform for next-generation ion batteries. Permanent, accessible molecular cavities can be tailored to coordinate and shield mobile ions, creating opportunities to improve ion mobility and conductivity while addressing stability and safety.

July 28, 2025 · Advanced Materials

Beyond Crystallinity: Mapping the Future of Non-Crystalline Metal–Organic Frameworks

A comprehensive review co-authored by Mehran Arzani examines design strategies, synthetic routes, characterization, processing, and scale-up for non-crystalline metal–organic frameworks, treating disorder as a useful design variable rather than only a structural limitation.

April 21, 2026 · ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces

A Zinc–Nitrate Battery Turns a Water Pollutant into Ammonia—and Electrical Power

A conductive Co₃(HITP)₂ catalyst couples nitrate remediation with an energy-producing zinc–nitrate battery. The reported device reaches approximately 1.45 V open-circuit potential and 5.3 mW cm⁻² maximum power density while demonstrating selective nitrate-to-ammonia conversion.
